comment: Jun 30: Cunningham (illness) missed Tuesday's practice, Tony East of The Next reports.
Jun 27: Brochant exited Saturday's 89-80 win over the Tempo with an apparant left ankle injury and did not return, WNBA reporter Stephen PridGeon-Garner reports.
Jun 28: Amoore won't return to Sunday's game against the Fire due to right knee soreness, and she'll finish with two points (0-3 FG, 0-3 3Pt, 2-2 FT) and three assists in 12 minutes.
